_doc: Rows excused from tools/check/tolerance-diff.mjs: {file, line, reason}. `line` is a substring of the ADDED assertion line. A row that matches nothing in the diff is reported stale; delete it. Every row needs a reason a reviewer can read (AGENTS.md rule 9: never widen a tolerance to get green).

exceptions.reason: Not a tolerance: the pinned value is the top of the car surface-id range in the WGSL classifier. Garage finishes add ids 36 (tinted chrome), 37 (chameleon) and then 38 (forged carbon), 39 (gunmetal), 40 (gold plate) under FINISH_RESERVED, so the classifier bound moves 33 -> 37 -> 40 in GLX, TLX and WGX together; the 18 design-lane finishes (ids 60-85, design wave 2 #3169) move it to 90 (the surface-id-parity headroom over the top shipped id, 85). car-materials/livery-finish-contract tests pin the new ids.

Layout foundation on deploy measured blocking 236233 B (ceiling 236800 B). Menu fit on #4179 adds ~2.5 KiB of first-paint rules in menu-destinations.css (play-door subtitles, wide-sheet measure, mb-vs en-dash guard). Post-merge measured 238718 B; the 239000 B ceiling is a bound on that census, not a drive-by widen.
Preload set matches TITLE_CRITICAL; same measured 238718 B census and bound as the blocking row on #4179.

Not a widened tolerance: the count is of real graph nodes, and #5294 (audit W19 row 5) deleted one of them, the legacy ERS whine chain (ersOsc/ersHp/ersGain) whose ersGain fed focus. ErsLayer is always defined (real or stub.js), so the chain was unreachable. The five remaining outputs are engine/sub/whine/harvest/reverb, as the message says; audio-tune's 'the engine graph builds no legacy ERS whine' pins the deletion.

Not a looser check: the cockpit body gains a deliberate 24-triangle carbon liner inside each shoulder bolster (js/car/car3d.js) so the road no longer shows through the car's sides in COCKPIT/HELMET on wide phones (Bryce 2026-11-18, PR #5745). The exact count is pinned in tests/data/car-wing-foil-tris.json (cockpit 1579 -> 1603) and the occlusion it buys is proven by tests/unit/cockpit-side-occlusion.test.mjs.

Bryce's own `decision: A` on #7155 (comment 7210067221, 2026-11-27): the PACE-scaled wall and side-rub scrubs (#7147) put monza seed 1 at a 1.47 % teammate gap, so the bound moves 1.4 -> 1.5, still inside the 0.67-1.49 % band the test header measured before #6575. His call accepting the new physics, not an agent widening.
